select distinct from rail_audit_workflow w inner join rail_audit_task t on t.workflow_id = w.workflow_id and t.task_status = 'TODO' left join sys_role r on r.role_key = t.role_key and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.role_id
and (t.assignee_id = #{currentUserId} or (t.assignee_id is null and ur.user_id = #{currentUserId}))
and w.flow_code = #{flowCode} and w.project_name like concat('%', #{projectName}, '%') and w.workflow_status = #{workflowStatus}
order by w.update_time desc, w.workflow_id desc
